modules.module_title: Carrying out manicure and pedicure services

pcs.pc_description: remove any existing nail polish using approved products and procedures before proceeding further
enquire to establish the desired length and shape of nails (hands or toes) with the client
file the nails ensuring the nails free edge is left smooth and shaped to required length according to the clients preference
remove dirt in the underside of the nails using nail pick, clippers, nail brush, soaking and washing to be dirt free
use suitable cuticle tools and products, safely and effectively, to remove excess cuticle, ensuring that the cuticle and nail plate are undamaged

use specialized procedures (hand and leg, finger and toe nails) to improve the appearance of the clients skin and nails (Procedures: File, buff and shape, cuticle pushing, clipping, massage, polish, etc.)
use smooth and even massage techniques for hands and lower arms, lower legs and feet and apply appropriate pressure to meet the clients needs
remove any excessive hard skin using a foot scrapper during the manicure service without discomfort to the client

leave the hands and lower arm, foot and lower leg free of any excess massage medium at the end of the pedicure or manicure process respectively, by clearing these using a towel or other suitable materials
check that the nail plate is dehydrated and the underside is clean and free of debris
apply sufficient base coat, polish coats and top coats as required to achieve the desired nail finish
check that the final nail finish is smooth, even textured and uniformly coloured, with the cuticle and nail wall free of enamel
check the clients comfort and wellbeing throughout the service and adapt procedures to ensure the same, reassure the client with necessary information and positive comments as required
clean the treated area and use a suitable soothing product
complete the therapy to the satisfaction of the guest in a commercially acceptable time
record the therapy accurately and store information securely in line with the organizations policies
provide specific after-procedure, homecare advice and recommendations for product use and further services to the client
ask questions to check with the client their satisfaction with the finished result
thank customer for feedback post-service, where customer is not satisfied with service take actions to resolve matter to customer satisfaction or apologise for the same and refer to supervisor

pcs.pc_description: adhere to the health and safety standards laid out by the manufacturer and organization
position self and client throughout the procedure in a way to ensure privacy, comfort and wellbeing
sanitize the hands prior to treatment commencement using a hand sanitiser
prepare the client for the treatment and provide suitable protective apparel
ask relevant and effective questions to check and establish the client's understanding, requirements and expectation prior to commencement and clarify doubts, if any
clean the nails to ensure they are free from bacteria
use a soak, hand wash, sanitizer, dis- incrustation wipes, anti-septic solutions
set-up products, tools, equipment and techniques to efficiently and safely deliver services suiting clients needs
prepare products for application, by mixing the ingredients in the correct proportions as per manufacturer instructions and organisation standards and place for ease of use by the nail technician
promptly refer problems that cannot be solved to the relevant person/ nail technician for action
remove any existing nail polish or nail enhancement to restore the nails to a natural condition, if required
identify the condition of the nails and any corrective work to suit the clients natural nail shape and condition
prepare the nail plate by removing debris, filing the free edge remove shine and dehydrate the natural nail

identify and select the correct products and tools for the UV nail enhancement job Products: clear gel, gel polish, base and builder gels, dehydrator, primer, nail tips, nail glue, nail art etc. Tools: tip clippers, pushers, 180-240 grit filer, brush
use primers to remove oils safely, protecting the skin
use glue correctly to attach the acrylic nail tips to the natural nail accurately protecting the skin from the glue
shorten the nail tips to the desired length and blend the tips
apply UV gel layers in the correct sequence

perform the correct application of UV gel and filing technique to leave the nail balanced with the required shape and length with guidance from the supervisor, applying the tip to the natural nail accurately and in line with natural nail
apply the base and builder gel evenly to the nail without touching the cuticle, curing under UV/LED lamp after each application
repeat the builder gel application if necessary to achieve desired thickness of the gel
perform buffing techniques correctly on UV gel enhanced nail and seal to create a high shine finish, achieving the desired shape and thickness
monitor UV curing timing to ensure adherence to product manufacturers instructions
use a coat of clear polish or paint them with coloured nail polish as required
apply the polish to the entire nail to create a smooth, even surface
repair UV gel enhancements to restore desired look with guidance from the supervisor

modules.module_title: Apply acrylic (powder and liquid) nail enhancements

pcs.pc_description: identify and select the correct products and tools for the acrylic nail enhancement job Products: monomer (ethyl methacrylate), acrylic powder, dehydrator, primer, nail tips, nail glue, nail art etc. Tools: tip clippers, pushers , 180-240 grit filer, Dappen dish and brush
follow in accordance with manufacturers instructions to adapt and combine liquid and powder colours for application of acrylic nail enhancements
use primers to remove oils safely, protecting the skin
use glue correctly to attach the acrylic nail tips to the natural nail accurately protecting the skin from the glue
pour the liquid and powder in different bowls in a well ventilated area
apply the liquid and powder to the brush in the correct order, ratio and consistency
apply the acrylic evenly to the nail without touching the cuticle
ensure the acrylic is dried before moving on to the next step
use a buffer to buff the surface of the nails, with an increasing grit file to achieve the desired shine
use a coat of clear polish or paint them with coloured nail polish as required
identify and resolve any problems with the nail enhancements seeking help from supervisor as required
perform nail repair technique to restore the nail enhancement following guidance of the supervisor
finish the nails evenly with a clear defined line ensure the work area is kept clean and tidy during the service
use work methods to minimise wastage
complete the service to the satisfaction of the client in a commercially acceptable time
check the natural nail plate and surrounding skin is undamaged and free from product
refer problems that cannot be solved to the relevant person or supervisor promptly
clean up the work area post-service to maintain the health and safety standard
provide after care advise for specific after- procedure, homecare advice and recommendations for protecting and maintaining the nail enhancement to the client
dispose waste materials as per organisational standards in a safe and hygienic manner
record details of the procedure accurately as per organisational policy and approved practice
store information securely in line with the salons policies
ask questions to check with the client their satisfaction with the finished result
thank customer for feedback post-service, where customer is not satisfied with service take actions to resolve matter to customer satisfaction or apologise for the same and refer to supervisor
